findings.message: The k9 søknad built for an income report is a plain `Aktivitetspenger` ytelse with `søknadsperiode` set to the reporting period. Nothing marks it as a report. The Ungdomsytelse version sets `UngSøknadstype.RAPPORTERING_SØKNAD` for this. A user reports income for the period 2026-03-01..2026-03-31. The JSON journalført to the archive, and passed on to downstream processing, is an ordinary Aktivitetspenger søknad with søknadsperiode March 2026 and no type marker. A consumer that reads the k9 format can take it for a new Aktivitetspenger application for that month instead of an income report. It is also validated with `AktivitetspengerSøknadValidator`, which may reject it if that validator expects fields from a real application (e.g. forutgående bosteder).
